title: Crown of Ashes
description: A fallen princess must marry her enemy to reclaim a burning kingdom.

parts.text: The crown felt like lead on her head. It was no longer a symbol of power, but of her failure.
He stood across the hall, the man who had burned her city to the ground. Now, he was her husband.
"I will not be your pawn," she whispered to the shadows. "I will be your downfall."
